name: Elle
source:
"My body is mechanical and my brain is electronics. But you would still shed tears the same way if I died?"

A Mechanical Doll that is an A Class Hunter with Bountia.
Because he is a machine he doesn't show much emotion, but he is especially kind to the protagonist.

Apparent Age: [spoiler]19[/spoiler]
Real Name: [spoiler]Noah[/spoiler]
